about_the_game:
In the Twinkleby demo, you’ll be able to decorate an island of your own with a set collection of items and customisation options. But if you keep an eye out, you’ll be able to unlock more as you play!

Twinkleby is a cozy decoration game where you build neighbourhood dioramas on floating islands. Create elaborate environments, set down your houses and furnish them with the items you discover. Customise the mood and lighting to tailor your dreamscape to your own wishes.

Prepare to encounter two quirky residents who want to make themselves at home. These characters have their own personalities, choosing how they interact with the environment and each other.

In Twinkleby, the world is your inventory. Throw anything you don’t want off the side of the island, and it will be returned to your collection. Rebuild, redesign, and unlock new ways to customise using colours, wallpapers, and sceneries. As you change the scenery, you change the soundtrack and gradually gain further control over the ambience of your dreamscape.

In the Twinkleby demo, you can:

✦ Decorate a floating island with a collection of items that will expand as you play.

✦ Furnish two dollhouses for the characters that will make their way to your little corner of space.

✦ Compose the soundtrack of your diorama using the weathers, seasons and backdrops.

✦ Enjoy escapist, cozy, relaxing gameplay without the stress of lose conditions and
game overs.

  • Processor: 2.0GHz 4-Core (Intel / AMD)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970 | AMD Radeon R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 11

Recommended:

  • Processor: 3.0GHz 8-Core (Intel / AMD)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: Twinkleby is a cozy decoration game where you map out an archipelago of floating islands and build dioramas for a society of spacefaring neighbours. Try out a little piece of the upcoming game in this demo!
